title: Hokey religions
content: Hokey religions and ancient weapons are no match for a good blaster at your side, kid. Help me, Obi-Wan Kenobi, you're my only hope, the hologram of Princess Leia pleaded. Luminous beings are we, not this crude matter, Yoda said, poking Luke with his stick. The Force will be with you, always, Obi-Wan's voice echoed as Luke switched off his targeting computer. So this is how liberty dies, with thunderous applause, Padme whispered in the Senate chamber.

title: Let the Wookiee win, C-3PO advised
content: Let the Wookiee win, C-3PO advised, and R2-D2 beeped in reluctant agreement. Hokey religions and ancient weapons are no match for a good blaster at your side, kid. I am a Jedi, like my father before me, Luke declared, tossing his lightsaber aside. Never tell me the odds, Han Solo replied, steering the Millennium Falcon into the asteroid field. I know, Han replied when Leia told him she loved him, and then the carbonite froze him solid.

title: The Force will be with you
content: The Force will be with you, always, Obi-Wan's voice echoed as Luke switched off his targeting computer. These aren't the droids you're looking for, Obi-Wan said with a wave of his hand. Do or do not, there is no try, said Yoda, lifting the X-wing from the swamp. I am a Jedi, like my father before me, Luke declared, tossing his lightsaber aside. You were the chosen one! It was said that you would destroy the Sith, not join them!
